title: Alternative positive channels for the Weil/screw kernel

verdict.conclusion: the gamma-factor Weyl channel independently fixes the non-lacunary spectral density and unit cusp coefficient; the zero-ordinate projection adds exact arithmetic spectral locations without assuming their horizontal confinement; neither equals the screw kernel unconditionally

archimedeanWeylChannel.derivation: Riemann-von Mangoldt mean density (1/(2*pi)) log(lambda/(2*pi)) multiplied by screw weight 2/lambda^2
archimedeanWeylChannel.interpretation: the local cusp and its normalization are archimedean zero-density effects, not consequences of decimal scaling
archimedeanWeylChannel.limitation: continuous mean density omits the fluctuating zero/prime measure and is not the exact global screw kernel

ordinateProjectionChannel.convergence: follows from the unconditional Riemann-von Mangoldt zero count
ordinateProjectionChannel.horizontalCorrection: the one-zero correction 2 Re[(cosh((eta+i gamma)t)-1)/(eta+i gamma)^2] minus its eta=0 projection changes sign
ordinateProjectionChannel.missingData: the channel deliberately discards beta-1/2, so equality is precisely the horizontal-confinement problem

primeWeylSamplingChannel.measure: (1/pi) sum_{q=p^k, log q>2*pi} [Lambda(q)/q] [log(log(q)/(2*pi))/(log q)^2] delta_{log q}
primeWeylSamplingChannel.asymptoticJustification: the prime number theorem turns (Lambda(q)/q) sampling into d lambda at frequency lambda=log q
primeWeylSamplingChannel.limitation: the exact explicit formula uses Lambda(q)/sqrt(q) delayed hinges, not these positive spectral weights

polyaChannel.regularity: super-exponential decay of Phi gives finite moments and a t^2 diagonal
polyaChannel.logConcavityImpact: even a completed proof of log-concavity would not change this moment regularity

channelScorecard.name: Existing inverse-square Rankin splice channel
channelScorecard.arithmeticSupport: decimal subsequence of the all-integer log spectrum

channelScorecard.name: Third-splice harmonic boundary channel
channelScorecard.verdict: right order; wrong coefficient, modulation and arithmetic support

channelScorecard.name: Archimedean Weyl-density channel
channelScorecard.cusp: t log(1/t) with exact unit leading coefficient
channelScorecard.arithmeticSupport: continuous mean zero density from the gamma factor
channelScorecard.verdict: best independent local channel; misses discrete prime/zero fluctuations

channelScorecard.name: Unconditional zero-ordinate projection channel
channelScorecard.cusp: t log(1/t) with exact unit leading coefficient
channelScorecard.arithmeticSupport: actual imaginary ordinates of all nontrivial zeros, horizontal displacement discarded
channelScorecard.verdict: exact under RH; equality with the arithmetic screw kernel is itself RH-equivalent

channelScorecard.name: Positive prime-power sampling of the Weyl density
channelScorecard.cusp: t log(1/t) asymptotically under the prime number theorem
channelScorecard.verdict: right support type and mean cusp; wrong weights and turns events into frequencies

channelScorecard.name: Direct Pólya-kernel Fourier feature channel
channelScorecard.cusp: t^2 because every moment is finite
channelScorecard.verdict: log-concavity cannot repair the regularity mismatch

channelScorecard.name: Signed explicit-formula/Krein channel
channelScorecard.arithmeticSupport: exact prime-power hinges plus archimedean completion
channelScorecard.verdict: exact but indefinite; the missing theorem is conversion to a Hilbert norm

channelScorecard.name: Recovery-witness reserve channel
channelScorecard.exactWeilIdentity: would follow from C_q-J_q=||R_q||^2 at every witness
channelScorecard.circular: if positivity of C_q-J_q is assumed

channelScorecard.name: Real zero-spectrum Hilbert channel
channelScorecard.verdict: the desired factorisation after the theorem has been assumed

comparisonWithThirdSplice.conclusion: the gamma normalization supplies the factor missing from the fixed decimal boundary channel, but replacing one measure by the other is a new arithmetic construction, not a splice identity

remainingRoute.requirement: identify an independently positive correction carrying the fluctuating difference between the continuous gamma density and the exact prime/zero distribution
remainingRoute.equivalentArithmeticForm: prove C_q-J_q is a norm square at every recovery witness
remainingRoute.warning: the ordinate channel or real-zero Hilbert factor cannot prove equality without resolving horizontal zero displacement
